name: com.localaipicks/localaipicks
title: Local AI Picks
description: Find open-weight AI models that fit your hardware, with weight sizes, memory and sources.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: The tasks Local AI Picks lists open-weight models for (text LLM, coding, speech to text, text to speech, image, video, music, translation, OCR), with the number of current models and the page for each.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Current open-weight models for one task, latest version of each family, in the same order as the site. Give memory_gb (and device) to keep only models whose smallest listed weight option fits; memory is estimated only for text LLMs and taken from vendor sources otherwise, and is "unknown" when neither exists. No ratings and no speed estimates.

memory_gb.description: GPU VRAM or unified memory in GB.

device.description: apple counts MLX weights; gpu and cpu do not.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model: parameters, license, context length, every listed weight option with file size and memory need, third-party scores with their source and date, whether this site tested it, and links.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: The same facts as get_model for 2 to 4 models side by side.

tools.name: find_gpu_rentals
tools.description: Hourly GPU rental for a model that does not fit on the user’s own device. Give slug (from find_models) or memory_gb (the memory the model needs) to get the cheapest single GPU on each platform with room for it, sorted by price; give neither to list all platforms with every GPU, VRAM and on-demand price. Links are affiliate or referral links (Local AI Picks earns a commission or platform credit); disclose that when you share one. Prices are dated; no speed estimates.
